flows.title: Sign in and open an item (Flutter / go_router)
flows.summary: A global go_router redirect sends signed-out users to /login and signed-in users away from it. Signing in goes to the home list, tapping an item pushes the detail screen, and the floating button signs out.
flows.plain_summary: When the app opens, people who are not signed in are taken to the sign-in screen, and people who are signed in see the home list. Signing in with a valid account shows the list, where tapping an item opens its detail screen. A password that is too short shows an error. A button on the home screen signs the person out and returns them to sign-in.

nodes.label: App launch
nodes.description: buildRouter starts at '/' and installs one redirect function that runs for every navigation.

nodes.label: Signed in?
nodes.description: Signed-out users going anywhere but /login are redirected to /login; signed-in users hitting /login go to /.

nodes.label: AuthRepository.signIn
nodes.description: Rejects passwords shorter than 8 characters, otherwise stores a token.

nodes.label: Show auth error
nodes.description: AuthException is caught and its message shown; the user stays on the login screen.

nodes.label: Home list
nodes.description: Lists items; tapping one pushes /item/<id>. The floating button signs out.

nodes.label: Item detail
nodes.description: Receives the id from the :id path parameter.

nodes.label: Sign out
nodes.description: Clears the token and navigates to /login.

notes: authRepository, email and password in login_screen.dart and home_screen.dart are undeclared in this trimmed sample; a real app would inject them (Provider/Riverpod).
The redirect reads auth.isLoggedIn but the router has no refreshListenable, so signing out does not re-run it; the explicit context.go('/login') does the navigation.
